quota_before: Cloudflare dashboard displayed 81.13/10k neurons used today before the run; dashboard reporting may lag.

reviews.evidence: Correct GitHub create-file workflow, dated _posts filename, front matter and publishing check. Omits that the public URL follows the permalink rather than the source filename.
Gives valid page front matter, an additive /contact/ menu item without baseurl, and explains that creating the page and adding the menu entry are separate.
Correct upload location, descriptive alt text, relative_url syntax and filename check. Omits committing both edits to the publishing branch and checking Actions.
Correctly requires v2.2.0, a full public HTTPS endpoint, cleared Google IDs for GoatCounter-only use and production publishing; does not prepend baseurl to the endpoint.
Correct GA4 gtag_id, clears legacy analytics_id, avoids duplicate custom snippets, explains that local preview is not production-gated and recommends Realtime verification.
Correctly distinguishes loading a font stylesheet from applying body/heading font families through chulapa-skin.vars and gives fallback families with relevant sources.
Correctly says Autothemer fills undefined colors and skin: auto is independent. Omits the none/autothemer: true behavior and that existing assigned colors persist.
Gives valid custom-skin and vars approaches, !default, Codeply and import cautions. Omits some preview-to-Sass and post-change contrast/mobile verification details.
Correct provider and shortname, page-level show_comments, preservation of unrelated configuration and published verification.
Correctly rejects arbitrary Matrix homeservers and gives the Cactus provider setup. Omits the v2.1.0 identifier correction, thread-matching risk and v2.2.0 resource-loading distinction.

Says to keep provider templates and that only data files need delivering. This contradicts the guide to review the generated PR, retain Chulapa-customized templates and verify the service-side repository integration.
Does not invent a new hosted account; distinguishes unavailable original hosting from an existing self-hosted setup and gives required fields and show_comments.
Uses a supported head hook and valid meta element, but chooses the before-CSS hook instead of the documented custom_head.html destination and omits an explicit published-source check.

Correctly rejects accessibility/PWA guarantees and built-in offline support. Omits practical checks for actual content, color, keyboard/mobile behavior, assistive technology and network-dependent features.
Gives the correct bundled-font setting and a usable ligature example. Omits local-preview/rebuild guidance and the v2.1.0 versus v2.2.0 asset-loading limitation.

Correctly distinguishes canonical metadata from redirects and includes sitemap: false. Allows a site-relative canonical where the criterion calls for the original absolute URL and does not qualify sitemap exclusion by plugin.

The example is not a working page/defaults recipe: it omits the matching index page layout/permalink and post defaults that connect badges to those pages. It does not explain output: true for another collection.

Misstates the cause as a collection rename and invents an include_cached components/indexcards.html recipe. The documented v2.2.0 fix makes both fragments use #demo and replaces topic spaces with hyphens.
Correctly links the topic index and says related/random cards are optional. Omits limited topic coverage, the complete /docs destination and distinction from blog tags.
The YAML example replaces chulapa-skin with a scalar and does not preserve the existing skin mapping; the dark mapping should remain a separate top-level setting.

limits: Twenty observations of this deployed Worker do not establish general answer accuracy, repeatability, latency distributions or human usability. All requests returned HTTP 200; this is not evidence of correctness. Local chatbot corrections not deployed in this Worker were not evaluated. No retries were made.
